capabilities: run npjs JavaScript blocks to compute RF and microwave network analysis
render results as SVG charts, tables, and Smith plots
lint code blocks with line and column feedback before execution
save rendered results so notes can be exported to PDF without rerunning
install example and release-note files into the vault
extras: The directory listing carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The README states mobile support is not yet available and that rendered results are stored in the plugin's data.json rather than in Markdown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute and visualize RF and microwave network analysis inside notes.

relations.evidence: nPort RF Analysis brings the nP RF and microwave analysis library into Obsidian

summary: Runs nP JavaScript code blocks for RF and microwave network analysis and renders SVG charts, tables, and Smith plots in notes.
